expected_structural_delta: Five primary modules; one feature root; zero new hops, production modules, owners, consumers, event or public-operation families. One private per-attempt proof. Forecast production lines +90/-20; tests at most two files +260/-0 lines.
minimum_design: Extend the existing Dynamic/Static/WAN/Network path to acknowledge completed nginx application. Static owns one private current-attempt completion proof, invalidated before stop. Reuse requires that proof; settings explicitly stop before changing config; metadata updates preserve timeout.
outcome: Repeated healthy Static Remote Access starts avoid nginx reloads; failed or incomplete reloads remain retryable while stop, timeout, settings and UPnP effects are preserved.

reuse_decisions.name: Static/Dynamic remote access lifecycle
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing owners retain transition and completion responsibilities; early running type keeps pending stop routing.

reuse_decisions.name: WAN events and nginx reload result
reuse_decisions.rationale: Return and await existing boolean result through current event path; no new event or acknowledgement framework.

reuse_decisions.name: Settings and URL metadata
reuse_decisions.rationale: Explicit settings transitions retain network effects; repeated cloud metadata does not reset timeout.
